name: Tyrannosaurus rex
description: One of the most famous and powerful predators to ever walk the Earth.

name: Spinosaurus
description: A giant prehistoric predator known for its distinctive sail and possible semi-aquatic lifestyle.

name: Triceratops
description: A large herbivorous dinosaur recognized by its three horns and massive skull frill.

name: Stegosaurus
description: A famous herbivorous dinosaur with large plates along its back and spikes on its tail.

name: Velociraptor
description: A small but agile predatory dinosaur related to other feathered dromaeosaurs.

name: Brachiosaurus
description: A gigantic long-necked dinosaur that used its height to reach vegetation.
